body: On an aged oak table stands a clear crystal sphere containing a miniature {{landscape}}. A waterfall from that tiny world flows through the glass boundary and cascades over the table edge into the surrounding room. Make the impossible transition seamless and visually readable. Photorealistic water, believable glass refraction, moody window light, warm wood against cool turquoise water, one central object, cinematic still-life composition.

en.title: Crystal sphere waterfall
en.description: A miniature alpine world spills a waterfall out of a glass sphere and over an oak table.
en.body:
## How to use

Describe the landscape inside the sphere. Keep the water crossing the glass boundary and the table edge explicit: these two transitions create the illusion.

## Recorded result

The default landscape was generated with the built-in image tool on 2026-10-29. The exact provider model ID was not supplied. Changing the landscape has not yet been tested.

zh-Hans.title: 水晶球瀑布溢出桌面
zh-Hans.description: 水晶球内的微缩山谷化作瀑布，穿过玻璃并沿橡木桌边流下。
zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

填写水晶球里的景观，保留“水流穿过玻璃边界”和“沿桌边流下”两处描述，让不可能的空间关系清晰可见。

## 实测结果

默认山谷景观于 2026-10-29 使用内置图像工具生成。工具没有返回准确的模型 ID。修改景观后的效果尚未实测。
